amendment.reason: The v2 run developed policy collapse under Stage-A lr=1e-5 and beta=0.0: completion clipping approached 1.0, entropy fell to about 0.05, and updates 51-55 had zero within-group reward variance, zero loss, and zero gradient norm. The same pinned model/data/generation geometry previously completed 200 updates at lr=1e-6 without collapse.
amendment.change: Reduce the Stage-A learning rate from 1e-5 to the previously validated 1e-6. Keep beta=0.0 and every other scientific, data, generation, resource, checkpoint, safety, measurement, adaptation, and analysis setting unchanged.
amendment.supersedes: execution recipe only; v1/v2 configs, stopped runs, and commits remain immutable evidence
